explanation: The theorem says the K-theory projective class of a finite projective module M maps under a ring hom φ to the class of the extended module. It is about the library's own constructions, KTheory.ProjectiveClass.map, of, and ModuleCat.RightExtension.Obj. I searched Mathlib for ProjectiveClass, KTheory and RightExtension. The only RightExtension hits are Kan extension files, which are unrelated. I found no K₀ construction for projective modules in Mathlib, so there is no counterpart.
